# `fintech_txn_currency_matches_account`

> A transaction is always booked in its account's currency (no implicit FX).

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [fintech](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_fintech__transactions` (`fintech_silver.slv_fintech__transactions`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/fintech/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `currency = account_currency`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_fintech` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `fintech_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.fintech_txn_currency_matches_account`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`currency_mismatch`**: transaction currency differs from the account currency.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=fintech SCENARIO=currency_mismatch BATCH=2026-10-20_currency_mismatch
make pipeline DOMAIN=fintech BATCH=2026-10-20_currency_mismatch
```
